meta.listDescription: The photos you've saved for trying pieces on. Remove any of them whenever you like.
meta.newDescription: What makes a photo work, and how to take one in about a minute.

list.title: Your photos
list.subtitle: One photo is active at a time — that's the one your next try-on uses.
list.limit: You can keep up to {max} photos.

moderation.PENDINGHint: We check every new photo before it can be used. This usually takes a moment.
moderation.BLOCKEDHint: This one can't be used for a try-on. Add a different photo and we'll carry on from here.

deleteDialog.title: Delete this photo?
deleteDialog.body: The photo and its file are removed straight away. Your try-on images stay in your history — they're separate from the photo they came from.

empty.title: Add your first photo
empty.description: One full-length photo is all it takes. From there you can try on any piece in the collection.

guidance.title: What makes a photo work
guidance.subtitle: A minute spent here means your first attempt usually passes. Each drawing shows the idea, not a person.

fullBody.title: Full length, head to feet
fullBody.body: Leave a little room above your head and below your feet.

frontFacing.title: Face the camera straight on
frontFacing.body: Shoulders square, arms slightly away from your body.

plainBackground.title: A simpler background, if you have one
plainBackground.body: Any background is fine. A plainer one just helps the outfit read a little more clearly.

fittedClothing.title: Close-fitting clothes
fittedClothing.body: Loose or layered clothing hides the shape the piece has to sit on.

goodLight.title: Even, front-on light
goodLight.body: Daylight from a window works. Avoid strong shadows and backlight.

chestHeight.title: Phone at chest height
chestHeight.body: Ask someone to hold it level, or prop it up and use the timer.

guidance.privacyNote: Studio staff never see this photo. It's used only to generate your own try-ons.

upload.title: Add a photo
upload.labelHint: Optional. Helps you tell photos apart later — “daylight”, “indoors”.
upload.setActive: Use this photo for my next try-on
upload.passedBody: Everything checks out. Save it and pick a piece to try on.
upload.failedBody: Here's what to change. Each one is quick to fix.

saved.title: Photo saved
saved.description: It's ready to use. Pick a piece and try it on.

DECODE.label: Readable file
DECODE.fail: We couldn't open this file. Export it again from your gallery, or pick a different photo.

SUPPORTED_FORMAT.label: Format
SUPPORTED_FORMAT.fail: We accept JPEG, PNG, WebP and HEIC. This file is {type}.

MAX_FILE_SIZE.label: File size
MAX_FILE_SIZE.fail: This file is {actual}MB. Pick one under {max}MB, or let your phone export a smaller copy.

MIN_RESOLUTION.label: Resolution
MIN_RESOLUTION.fail: This photo is {width}×{height}. We need at least {minWidth}×{minHeight} — take it again with the camera app rather than a screenshot.

FULL_BODY_VISIBLE.label: Full body in frame
FULL_BODY_VISIBLE.fail: Your feet or your head are outside the frame. Step back, or ask whoever is holding the phone to move back a pace.
FULL_BODY_VISIBLE.failPortrait: This photo is wider than it is tall. Hold the phone upright so your whole outfit fits in.

SINGLE_SUBJECT.label: One person
SINGLE_SUBJECT.fail: There's more than one person in frame. Try one where it's just you.

NOT_BLURRY.label: Sharpness
NOT_BLURRY.fail: This one came out soft. Prop the phone against something steady, or use the timer instead of holding it.

ADEQUATE_LIGHTING.label: Light
ADEQUATE_LIGHTING.failDark: It's too dark to make out the outfit. Face a window, or turn on the room light.
ADEQUATE_LIGHTING.failBright: The light behind you is washing you out. Turn around so the light falls on you instead.

errors.title: Your photos didn't load
errors.description: The connection dropped on the way. Try again — nothing has been lost.
errors.CONSENT_REQUIRED: Before your first try-on we need your go-ahead on how your photo is used.
errors.CONSENT_STALE: We've updated how we handle your photo. Have a read and confirm to carry on.
errors.PHOTO_LIMIT_REACHED: You can keep up to {max} photos. Delete one to add another.
errors.PHOTO_VALIDATION_FAILED: This photo won't work for a try-on. Choose another and we'll check it before it's saved.
errors.PHOTO_BLOCKED_BY_MODERATION: Let's try a different photo — choose another and we'll carry on from here.
errors.PHOTO_NOT_FOUND: That photo has already been removed. Pick another or add a new one.
errors.IMAGE_TOO_SMALL: This image is too small to work from. Take it again with the camera app rather than a screenshot.
errors.IMAGE_FORMAT_UNSUPPORTED: That file type won't upload. Pick a HEIC, WebP, PNG or JPEG photo instead.
errors.IMAGE_TOO_LARGE: That file is too big. Pick a smaller one and we'll compress it for you.
errors.IMAGE_CORRUPT: We couldn't read that file. Export it again from your gallery.
errors.UPLOAD_TICKET_INVALID: That upload didn't complete. Choose the photo again and we'll start over.
errors.UPLOAD_TICKET_EXPIRED: That upload took longer than the link lasts. Choose the photo again.
errors.STORAGE_WRITE_FAILED: The photo didn't save. Try again.
errors.RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED: That's a few uploads in a row. Give it a minute and try again.
errors.AUTH_REQUIRED: Sign in to save a photo.
errors.SESSION_EXPIRED: Your session has ended. Sign in again and we'll bring you back here.
errors.ACCOUNT_SUSPENDED: This account is on hold. Contact the studio and we'll sort it out.
errors.NETWORK_ERROR: You appear to be offline. We'll finish the upload when you're back.
errors.REQUEST_TIMEOUT: That took too long. Try again.
errors.SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE: We're briefly unavailable. Try again shortly.
errors.INTERNAL_ERROR: The photo didn't save. Try again — we've been notified.
